thread:
rachel: FYI: launching new micro-burst Dedicated pools (A10G+ and H200p) in ams and sfo next week. Purpose: lower-latency short allocations for PLG customers and bursty inference jobs. Start: Mon May 4 2026 00:00 UTC.

rachel: Key bullets: 1) pools: ams-micro-a10gplus (20 nodes), ams-micro-h200p (12 nodes), sfo-micro-a10gplus (16 nodes); 2) per-account micro-burst quota defaults to 8h/day (can request uplift); 3) new micro-burst price multiplier = 1.15x base dedicated rate; 4) micro-burst windows are 6h max per allocation, auto-evict on soft-fair-share.

ops-bot: Rollout created: roll/microburst-v1. Canary sequence: sfo-canary -> ams-canary. Canary start: 2026-05-04T01:00Z. Alert channels: #dedicated-ops #sales #billing.

theo: Is this a replacement for existing burst pools or a new class? What about customers currently using 24/72h burst windows?

rachel: It's a new class. Existing long-burst pools unchanged for now. Micro-burst targets short-running workloads (interactive inference, demos). For customers who need longer windows we recommend reserved short-term (48h) or legacy burst pools (they remain available while capacity lasts). Migration docs: <internal://dedicated/microburst-onboarding>.

laura: How will the scheduler handle fairness between Reserved and Micro-burst? Any priority inversion risk?

rachel: Scheduler notes: micro-burst uses low-latency lane with preemptible priority lower than Reserved but higher than public shared pools. We added a soft-fair-share semaphore to reduce priority inversion: if Reserved demand spikes, micro-burst gets drained gracefully over 30-90s rather than immediate hard-kill.

matt: Billing question: is the 1.15x applied per-node-hour or per-GPU-hour? Any rounding rules for billing previews?

rachel: It's per-GPU-hour. Billing preview available in Console under "Dedicated -> Micro-burst pricing preview". Rounding: billed to the nearest minute. We also surfaced an estimated monthly impact tile for accounts with frequent micro-burst usage.

laura: Need runbook for oncall. Also add a metric to track preemption counts and avg drain-time per pool.

ops-bot: Playbook stub uploaded: <internal://playbooks/microburst-oncall>. Metrics: microburst.preempt.count, microburst.drain.time_ms, microburst.allocation.latency_p95. Grafana dash created: infra/dedicated/microburst.

matt: Can customers opt-out of micro-burst pricing if they want to use old burst behavior?

rachel: Yes. Accounts can opt-out via Console feature-flag (Dedicated -> Pool settings -> MicroBurst opt-out) or file a request with sales for org-wide opt-out. Opted-out accounts will continue to be eligible for legacy burst pools where capacity exists, billed at existing rates.

laura: Legal question: any TOS changes or required customer notification language for the price multiplier?

legal-bot: We've prepared a short notice template and updated the Dedicated Addendum: <internal://legal/dedicated-pricing-notice>. Required: 14-day notice to active Dedicated customers who have consumed > 10 burst hours in the last 30 days. System will auto-email qualifying accounts.

rachel: CLI helpers: to view micro-burst usage and quotas run: `redwoodctl dedicated microburst --region ams --account $ACCT --usage` and to request uplift: `redwoodctl quota request --type microburst --hours 24 --reason "demo days"`.

ops-bot: Canary: sfo-canary completed with no regressions. Canary: ams-canary started 2026-05-04T03:15Z. Full rollout target: 36h pending metrics. Rolling notes posted to #dedicated-ops.

theo: Can we include a short FAQ snippet for support and sales outlining typical customer questions and answers?

rachel: Done. Added FAQ to sales kit and support templates. I'll ping #sales and #support when console banners go live. :loud_sound:
